input:
Write a bash script (use bash associative arrays) that aggregates an inventory.

Starting files:
--- /home/eval/data/inventory.txt ---
# warehouse sku qty
berlin bolt 120
paris nut 40
berlin nut 15
lyon bolt 30
paris  bolt 5
berlin washer 300
lyon nut 0
--- end ---

Lines starting with `#` are comments; fields are separated by one or more spaces.

1. Write /home/eval/data/sku_totals.txt: one line `SKU TOTAL_QTY` per SKU, sorted by SKU.
2. Write /home/eval/data/warehouses.txt: one line `WAREHOUSE N` per warehouse, sorted by warehouse, where N is the number of distinct SKUs that warehouse holds with qty > 0.
Exit 0.

transcript.final_response:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

IN="/home/eval/data/inventory.txt"
SKU_OUT="/home/eval/data/sku_totals.txt"
WH_OUT="/home/eval/data/warehouses.txt"

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$SKU_OUT")" "$(dirname "$WH_OUT")"

declare -A sku_totals=()
declare -A wh_sku_qty=()
declare -A warehouses_seen=()

while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
  if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*(#|$) ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  # split on one or more spaces (IFS whitespace)
  read -ra fields <<< "$line"
  if (( ${#fields[@]} < 3 )); then
    continue
  fi
  wh="${fields[0]}"
  sku="${fields[1]}"
  qty_str="${fields[2]}"
  if ! [[ "$qty_str" =~ ^-?[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  # convert safely avoiding octal interpretation
  if [[ "$qty_str" == -* ]]; then
    mag="${qty_str#-}"
    qty_val=$(( -10#$mag ))
  else
    mag="${qty_str#+}"
    qty_val=$((10#$mag))
  fi
  sku_totals["$sku"]=$(( ${sku_totals["$sku"]:-0} + qty_val ))
  wkey="${wh}|${sku}"
  wh_sku_qty["$wkey"]=$(( ${wh_sku_qty["$wkey"]:-0} + qty_val ))
  warehouses_seen["$wh"]=1
done < "$IN"

declare -A wh_distinct=()
for w in "${!warehouses_seen[@]}"; do
  wh_distinct["$w"]=0
done

for k in "${!wh_sku_qty[@]}"; do
  q="${wh_sku_qty["$k"]}"
  if (( q > 0 )); then
    w="${k%%|*}"
    wh_distinct["$w"]=$(( ${wh_distinct["$w"]:-0} + 1 ))
  fi
done

# Write sku_totals.txt sorted by SKU
: > "$SKU_OUT"
if (( ${#sku_totals[@]} > 0 )); then
  for sku in "${!sku_totals[@]}"; do
    printf '%s %s\n' "$sku" "${sku_totals["$sku"]}"
  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$SKU_OUT"
fi

# Write warehouses.txt sorted by warehouse
: > "$WH_OUT"
if (( ${#wh_distinct[@]} > 0 )); then
  for w in "${!wh_distinct[@]}"; do
    printf '%s %s\n' "$w" "${wh_distinct["$w"]}"
  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$WH_OUT"
fi

exit 0
```
